actual_tools: CZ CELLxGENE Discover API via cellxgene-skill and local Python standard library
execution.implementation: Genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation plus deterministic preparation checks over official treatment-naive TNBC single-cell collection metadata

observations: The retained de-identified metadata describes 427,823 primary cells and reports an aggregate study-participant count of 101.
The record names 10x 3-prime v2 and v3 assays, 32,354 features, raw.X, and X_umap.
Seven broad ontology-backed cell-type labels are retained in the inventory.
A genuine Rosalind Workbench open call returned the exact task-chooser-ready message.
interpretation: The cohort and annotation inventory supports a reproducible plan for cell-state exploration while leaving cell-level biological claims to a future matrix analysis.
limitations: The H5AD asset, expression matrix, and cell-level annotations were not downloaded or analysed.
Broad labels do not establish cell proportions, states, or interactions.
The retained aggregate participant count cannot support participant-aware modelling without separately governed grouping data.
rosalind_open only opened the task chooser and did not run a single-cell analysis.

provenance.note: The official collection response and local script support the preparation summary; the separate 923-byte Rosalind observation supports launcher readiness only.

reproduction: Run python showcases/rosalind-workbench/cases/rosalind-single-cell-tme/build_case.py from the repository root.
Require the retained collection and dataset versions, 427,823 cells, an aggregate participant count of 101, and all four preparation checks.
Treat the Rosalind launcher receipt separately from the CELLxGENE metadata evidence.
Do not associate this metadata-only single-cell case with the pathology and Visium comparison task.
